scripts.build:telegram: mkdir -p public/telegram && cp apps/telegram-bot/web-src/index.html apps/telegram-bot/web-src/style.css public/telegram/ && esbuild apps/telegram-bot/web-src/wallet.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --outfile=public/telegram/wallet.js
scripts.check: node --check server/index.js && node --check src/notes.js && node --check src/merkle-tree.js && node --check src/market-keeper.js && node --check public/veil.js
scripts.circuits:compile: mkdir -p build/circuits && circom2 circuits/deposit.circom --r1cs --wasm --sym -o build/circuits && circom2 circuits/transfer.circom --r1cs --wasm --sym -o build/circuits && circom2 circuits/withdraw.circom --r1cs --wasm --sym -o build/circuits && circom2 circuits/swap.circom --r1cs --wasm --sym -o build/circuits && circom2 circuits/cancel-order.circom --r1cs --wasm --sym -o build/circuits && circom2 circuits/market-order.circom --r1cs --wasm --sym -o build/circuits && circom2 circuits/market-settlement.circom --r1cs --wasm --sym -o build/circuits
scripts.test: npm run build:client && npm run circuits:compile && node --test && forge test --force --offline
